==Biography==
===2014 Season===
Kim "'''GimGoon'''" Han-saem (also stylized '''Gimgoon''') joined [[Xenics Storm]] as their new top laner in October of 2014. The team made its debut at [[PANDORA.TV Champions Winter 2013-2014]], where they surprised many by qualifying for the playoffs. Unfortunately, they lost 3-1 in the quarterfinals to [[NaJin White Shield]]. The team disbanded shortly after the season ended. GimGoon joined [[Samsung Galaxy Blue]] as a sub but never played any games for them before he left in June of 2014. He then joined the [[KT Rolster Bullets]] as a sub and played two games for them at [[HOT6iX Champions Summer 2014]]. He left the team two weeks after the season ended.

===2015 Season===
GimGoon went to China to join the new team, [[Energy Pacemaker.All]], as their new top laner. They played in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Spring Season|2015 Demacia Cup Spring Season]] but lost 3-2 very early on to [[Team WE]]. EPA competed in the [[2015 LoL Secondary Pro League/Spring Season|2015 LSPL Spring Season]] but placed last in their group and missed playoffs. They were forced to play in the [[2015 LoL Secondary Pro League/Summer/Relegation|2015 LSPL Summer Relegation]] and requalified for the [[2015 LoL Secondary Pro League/Summer Season|2015 LSPL Summer Season]] with a 2-0 victory over [[Stand Point Gaming]]. EPA competed in the [[2015 Demacia Cup/Summer Season|2015 Demacia Cup Summer Season]] but lost 3-2 in the first round to [[Team King]]. They qualified for the [[2015 LoL Secondary Pro League/Summer Playoffs|2015 LSPL Summer Playoffs]] where they took first and automatically promoted to the [[LPL/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 LPL Spring Season]].
